title: File:Cueva de las manos - detalle.jpg
author: Suzko
used_as: the wall in every shot: the real rock low-passed and re-toned to the reference's cream wash; the photograph's own hand shapes (the negative stencil's bare-rock hand and the positive red hand's outline) printed as pale hands, with handmade blown-pigment halos sprayed round them; its eight largest guanaco silhouettes kept black, the smaller ones faded; the close-up is a x2.2 crop of the same toned wall.
